name: Shaman's kit
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 205
Price 15 gp; Weight 44 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, candles (10), a flint and steel, an iron pot, a mess kitUE, rope, soap, a spell component pouch, torches (10), trail rations (5 days), a waterskin, and a wooden holy symbol.
